scope: All F01-F30 modules plus cross-cutting authoring workflows
executionPolicy: Follow the current SKILL.md profile and transport matrix. Preserve the original requirements, import public-definition components together, and use only reachable CLI commands. Callables marked approved-external-adapter require an organization-approved profile and are not shipped CLI routes. No automatic reduced-scope deployment.

coverageMeaning.integrated: A selected basic path is composed by build/provision; consult listed limits.
coverageMeaning.separate-phase: A shipped CLI or Python helper supplies selected operations outside the base provisioner.
coverageMeaning.partial: Some operations have executable helpers; other requested branches require a complete contract.
coverageMeaning.guide-only: Business and property guidance is discoverable, but no complete creation command is shipped.

build.command: python plan.py build --model current-model.json --spec application.json --out draft
build.description: Construct Arial, rich headers, measure colors, visible native Home and Intelligence dashboards with mandatory Page Navigators.
build.inputs: Current model metadata; application spec with sheets, rows, columns and measures. See runtime-guide.md and fixtures/finance-spec.json for syntax; replace synthetic identities. Optional sheet.conditionalFormatting uses stable target/test measure keys; see conditional-formatting.md. Numeric Native columns default source Sum; sourceAggregation is separate from grid aggregation/columnAggregation. See numeric-column-values.md. Preserve the original request; emits buildRequest.json, importContract.json and construction.json. See verified-authoring-flow.md.

provision.command: python plan.py provision --config destination.json --model current-model.json --spec application.json --run run
provision.description: Create/resume the documented supported base application; do not auto-deploy a reduced scope. Separate selected helpers remain explicit phases.
provision.inputs: Authorized destination config, real model and supported application spec. requiredCapabilities describes the base phase; keep separate requested phases in the execution ledger.

export.command: python plan.py api export --config destination.json --run run --label baseline
export.description: Retrieve the full current definition, including asynchronous export completion.
export.inputs: Destination config: apiBase, workspaceId, planId, tokenEnvironment and allowedHosts.

decode.description: Decode the exported envelope and cache original part bytes/hashes.

update.command: python plan.py api update --config destination.json --payload candidate.json --run run --label update
update.description: Publish a scoped candidate using a fresh baseline guard and resumable operation journal.
update.inputs: Full candidate envelope; authorizedMutation, current baselineSha256 and destination config. Preserve unrelated part bytes with runtime.codec.patch.

input.command: python plan.py construct-native input --input input.request.json --out input.payload.json
input.description: Construct Number, ShortText, LongText, SingleSelect, MultiSelect, Date, Person, Checkbox or Simulation inputs; optional VisualColumn placement. New editable inputs explicitly use ReadAndEdit unless an explicit mode or formula condition is supplied.
input.inputs: JSON keyword arguments for input_create: measure_id, label, kind, settings, configuration_id; optional measures, dimensions, visual_column, context_bound, allow_input, on_change, cube_partition_measure_id and cube_model. Select settings can include advanced visual_identifier/columns metadata.

formula.command: python plan.py construct-native formula --input formula.request.json --out formula.payload.json
formula.description: Construct a typed formula with resolved symbolic measure references.
formula.inputs: JSON keyword arguments for formula_create: measure_id, label, formula, measures; optional visual_column, data_type and cube_partition_measure_id.

column-create.description: Create or resume a native column after destination identities exist; verify SQL columnType or OneLake dataInputType without duplicate creation. Current CLI: unavailable; invoke the listed callable only through an explicitly approved external profile
column-create.inputs: Application builder profile; request visual_id, payload and optional version. Complete asynchronous creation before registering dependents. See native-column-readback.md; keep the same authored measureGuid after a saved-record validation failure.

column-register.description: Register the created measure in visibility, aggregation and formatting companions. Current CLI: unavailable; invoke the listed callable only through an explicitly approved external profile
column-register.inputs: Request entity_id, visual_id, payload, row_aggregation, column_aggregation, format_entries and optional visible. Use returned destination IDs. Saved native type validation accepts the verified OneLake alias; native-column-readback.md.

forecast.description: Construct complete native Forecast via a Planning measure with kind Forecast. New editable inputs explicitly use ReadAndEdit unless an explicit mode or formula condition is supplied.
forecast.inputs: Measure key, label, kind=Forecast, actuals, start, end; optional openDefault/referenceForecast/periodUtc/timezone. Actual column hierarchy and optional sheet columnTimeLevels determine time extension.

forecast-review.description: Apply direct From Sheets SUM, quarterly text commentary, formula variance, negative formatting and comparison charts after base import. Current CLI: unavailable; invoke the listed callable only through an explicitly approved external profile
forecast-review.inputs: Adapt the named source/target sheets, measures and charts in examples/forecast-review.request.json to the current application. Resolve actuals, source Forecast and compatible destination grain.

forecast-repair.command: python plan.py forecast-repair --baseline definition.json --input examples/forecast-repair.request.json --out candidate.json
forecast-repair.description: Prepare a scoped Forecast correction from a user-supplied working reference; publish separately with api update.
forecast-repair.inputs: Fresh definition and adapted example specifying target/reference sheets and Forecast measures. Reuse bounds only for an identical horizon.

pivot.description: Activate an existing saved Pivot after building its symbolic configuration. Current CLI: unavailable; invoke the listed callable only through an explicitly approved external profile

powertable.description: Python callable constructs all five configured PowerTable ALM parts; merge its returned declaration/parts into the candidate before api create/update.

Optional allow_edit=False retains read-only key presentation; database lookups accept an ordered chain after the initial schema/table/key/label mapping.
